MasterUrlHint: The base URL the panel can be reached under in the format http://localhost:8080
RegistrationEnabledHint:
Self registered users can't do anything until given permissions

Disabling this only prevents direct registration, invitation to a server and the Users page are not affected
OidcEnabledHint: Adds a login button that signs in users who already exist in this panel. Users are never created automatically
OidcHidePasswordLogin: Show only the SSO button on the login page
OidcHidePasswordLoginHint: The password form stays available through a link below the button, e.g. when the identity provider is down
OidcIssuerHint: The provider's issuer, e.g. https://sso.example.com/application/o/pufferpanel/ (its /.well-known/openid-configuration must be reachable from the panel)
OidcClientSecretHint: Never shown again after saving; leave empty to keep the current secret
OidcRedirectUrlHint: Register this URL at the provider. Empty: the master URL followed by /auth/oidc/callback
OidcButtonTextHint: Text of the login button, e.g. "Login with Example SSO". Empty: "Login with SSO"
OidcUsernameClaimHint: Claim that holds the panel username. Empty: preferred_username
OidcRequireVerifiedEmailHint: Only accept the email when the provider reports it as verified (email_verified)
